receipts.context: (()=>{const r=document.querySelector('[aria-label="HVAC coordination result"]');for(const t of ['Sample network','plenum','beam','transition','review-noise','Not tested','unknown'])if(!r.textContent.includes(t))throw Error('Missing '+t);if(r.querySelector('[data-clash-count]').dataset.clashCount!=='1')throw Error('Expected one red run');r.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});return {issues:r.querySelector('.hvac-issues').innerText,canvas:r.querySelector('canvas').getBoundingClientRect().toJSON()};})()

receipts.context: (async()=>{if(window.__hvacDownloads.length!==3)throw Error('Expected three real Blob exports');window.__hvacArtifacts=await Promise.all(window.__hvacDownloads);if(window.__hvacArtifacts.some(x=>x.base64.length>30000))throw Error('Increase bounded artifact capture chunks');return {artifactLengths:window.__hvacArtifacts.map(x=>({type:x.type,length:x.base64.length}))};})()
